mira_csm: Heads-up: Kestrel Analytics showing sharp drop in DAUs after they added new model calls. Activation at risk.
ben_ae: Renewal in 32 days. Any specific feature gaps?
mira_csm: Streaming sessions fail mid-way, embedding accuracy complaints, and they saw auth errors during the demo.
olivia_onboard: Did their team apply the prompt templates? They said template merge errors were confusing. Offered to run a live pairing but they declined.
eli_support: We saw intermittent 401s from token refresh race condition, ticket INF-4021. Patch deployed yesterday.
mira_csm: Quick save plan: 1) 30-min triage + live pairing this week, 2) 30-day credits to re-run key demos, 3) downgrade-friendly export + 15-day retention hold, 4) one-pager RCA + recommended routing fallback.
ben_ae: I'll do the exec outreach. Can we schedule tomorrow afternoon?
olivia_onboard: I can do the live pairing and create a condensed "Quick Fix" snippet pack: `auth fix, template validation, recommended headers`.
eli_support: I'll prepare logs and a short mitigation note; suggest enabling regional fallback to reduce impact if errors recur.
coord_bot: Created task CS-REENGAGE-459 and scheduled reminder in 2 days.
mira_csm: Outreach draft ready, sending after tweaks. Post-call we'll run a 3-question pulse survey and tag Gainsight with outcome. Keep thread updates light.
